tagline.en: Fast 3D scene generation from a single image or a text prompt, built on the Wan2.2 backbone.
tagline.zh: 从单张图片或一段文字快速生成 3D 场景,底座基于 Wan2.2。

en: FlashWorld, from the FlashWorld team (imlixinyang), turns an image or a text prompt into a 3D scene. Instead of the slow, per-scene optimization that traditional 3D reconstruction relies on, it aims to produce a navigable scene quickly.

It builds on the Wan2.2 text-to-image/video backbone and pairs it with a scene representation you can render from new camera positions. You give it an image (or a prompt) and it generates the scene together with camera-conditioned views.
In WorldFoundry you run FlashWorld through the shared pipeline as an image-conditioned camera-scene task — provide an image, and it renders the generated scene along a camera path.
zh: FlashWorld 由 FlashWorld 团队(imlixinyang)开发,能把一张图片或一段文字提示词生成为 3D 场景。与传统 3D 重建依赖逐场景的缓慢优化不同,它的目标是快速产出可漫游的场景。
它以 Wan2.2 的文/图生成底座为基础,搭配可从新相机位姿渲染的场景表示。你给它一张图片(或提示词),它就会生成场景以及相机条件下的视角。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 以图像条件的相机场景任务运行 FlashWorld——提供一张图片,它便会沿相机轨迹渲染出生成的场景。

whenToUse.en: Reach for FlashWorld when you want to generate an explorable 3D scene from a single image or a prompt without running a lengthy per-scene reconstruction pass.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从单张图片或一段提示词生成可探索的 3D 场景,又不想跑一遍耗时的逐场景重建时,可以选择 FlashWorld。

notFor.en: It needs the FlashWorld and Wan2.2 checkpoints plus a CUDA GPU, so it is not a lightweight or CPU-only option. Checkpoints are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 它需要 FlashWorld 与 Wan2.2 的 checkpoint 以及一块 CUDA GPU,并非轻量或纯 CPU 方案。Checkpoint 需单独下载。

en: Generates a 3D scene from a single image or a text prompt
Built on the Wan2.2 TI2V backbone
Renders camera-conditioned views of the generated scene
Runs as an image-conditioned camera-scene task in WorldFoundry
zh: 从单张图片或文字提示词生成 3D 场景
基于 Wan2.2 TI2V 底座构建
可渲染生成场景的相机条件视角
在 WorldFoundry 中以图像条件相机场景任务运行
